# Zbrojní kvíz

> Bezplatný trenažér ke zkoušce odborné způsobilosti pro zbrojní oprávnění v České republice
> (zákon č. 90/2024 Sb., platný od 2026): všech 837 oficiálních testových otázek Ministerstva
> vnitra včetně obrázků, procvičování podle okruhů, opakování chyb a simulace zkoušky ve
> skutečném formátu (30 otázek, 40 minut, 26 správných k úspěchu, 28 u rozšířeného zbrojního
> oprávnění — zákon 90/2024 Sb. § 20 odst. 3). Bez registrace, bez reklam;
> funguje offline i na mobilu. Česky.

## What it is
- A practice app for the Czech firearms-licence theory exam ("zbrojní průkaz / zbrojní
  oprávnění", Act 90/2024 Sb.).
- Question bank: all 837 official questions extracted directly from the Ministry of the
  Interior's published PDF (not a third-party copy), with their images; the extraction
  reconciled and fixed errors found in older unofficial copies.
- Learning design: practice with immediate, calm feedback; mastery per okruh, not grades;
  missed questions resurface via spaced repetition ("weak-area drill"); persisted exam history.
- Exam simulation in the legal format: 30 questions, 40-minute timer, pass at 26/30
  (28/30 for the extended permit, "rozšířené zbrojní oprávnění") — Act 90/2024 Sb. § 20(3)(a).
  Composition per Government Regulation 238/2025 Sb. § 12: 17 legal + 5 weapons science
  + 5 safe handling + 3 first aid. The safe-handling questions are drawn from the official
  handling rules (q562–596) and safety principles (q784–799), since the Ministry's file does
  not label that part separately. Note: 60 questions / 57 to pass is the examiner's exam
  (§ 34), not the applicant's.
- Free, no account needed; optional Google / magic-link sign-in only to sync progress between
  devices. First-party anonymous usage counts only, no third-party trackers.

## How to use it
- https://zbrojnikviz.dravec.org/ — pick an okruh, drill weak spots, or start the mock exam;
  progress is kept on the device.
- Topic pages are real URLs under https://zbrojnikviz.dravec.org/okruh/… (see the sitemap).
- Every official question has a static page that works without JavaScript:
  https://zbrojnikviz.dravec.org/otazka/<number>/ (1–837, the numbering of the Ministry's file).
  It gives the three options, the correct answer as the Ministry marks it, and for 320 of the
  837 questions the provision that decides it (zákon č. 90/2024 Sb., NV č. 238/2025 Sb.,
  NV č. 187/2025 Sb., the criminal code), quoted verbatim with a link to the consolidated text. Example: https://zbrojnikviz.dravec.org/otazka/313/

## Data & provenance
- Official question set of the Ministry of the Interior (Ministerstvo vnitra ČR) for the
  2026 exam; extraction and verification notes:
  https://github.com/Chartres/zbrojni-kviz/blob/main/data/README.md
- A study aid, not the exam: the official test is administered by the Police of the Czech
  Republic.
